hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.rs$' || git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.rs$'; then CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 nice -n 10 cargo check --all-targets --message-format=short 2>&1 | grep '^error' | head -8; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep '\.rs$' | wc -l); if [ "$changed" -gt 0 ]; then echo "=== $changed Rust file(s) changed — run: make ci ==="; fi
